profile.headline: Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary:
Experienced software engineer specializing in developing realtime and offline computer graphics software and interactive entertainment.

Equal parts experience in realtime video game development and movie industry animation systems.

With a solid background in Computer Science education as foundation.

You get extra points if you figured out that's not me in the picture, and you know who it is :)

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Collaborated with one of Autodesk’s teams integrating Shotgun + Stingray technologies to build a prototype tool for review of 3D assets for production, using Shotgun’s python based Toolkit and Stingray’s Lua Interface.

	Part of Autodesk’s team working on its flagship production pipeline solution and Emmy Award winning software - Shotgun. Worked as a member of the Shotgun Toolkit (https://github.com/shotgunsoftware) team collaborating on its two most recent major releases: Zero-config and the new generation default configuration. Working on python based pipeline integrations for industry leading tools such as: Maya, 3dsMax, Nuke, Mari, etc. Participated with planning the next generation pipelines and tools based on the next evolution of Shotgun Toolkit.

positions.title: Software Engineer/Tech Lead
positions.description:
Member of the R&D software engineering team responsible for DWA’s next generation character rigging tool. Responsible for exposure to Python of different anim-rig engine subsystems. Extension of additional mesh visualization modes. Integration of mesh deformation technologies into the Luna environment, including interactive transformation manipulation of the deformation cage. Updated (de)serialization methods for several subsystems using a JSon-based format.

	Lead engineer of animation mixing for cloud based graphics pipeline platform. Responsibilities included the design and implementation of a motion synthesis system to leverage DWA’s vast animation assets. Implemented several animation interpolation methods for animation sequencing and transitioning. Designed and implemented an abstraction for animation sourcing to uniformly and transparently support data from various sources. Debugged and discovered unexpected and diverging results in the studio's pre-existing animation pipelines. Collaborated on the design and creation of tools and tests to aid in the verification animation correctness. In charge of scheduling, planning and task breakdown for the animation mixing module of the pipeline.  
 
 	Software engineer on the team that delivered DWA’s Academy Sci-Tech Award (Oscar) winning  character animation tool, Premo, used for the creation of DWA’s award winning computer animated films like How to Train your Dragon 2. Implemented an animation library module for authoring, organizing, applying and persisting animation poses and clips. Features included, different application modes: partial, mirroring, flipping, control sub-set targeting.

positions.title: Co-Lead Software Engineer and Co-Founder
positions.description: Co-designed, Co-programmed, Co-Produced Chicks on the Loose, iOS casual game. In charge of half of the technical and management responsibilities.

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description: Part of the software engineering team responsible for creating iDevice clients for  EA Mobile's game oriented social network Origin. Responsible for implementing the API/SDK that provides Origin services for ALL of EA Mobile games on iDevices. Tasks included UI screen implementation and polish. Network client-side related feature improvements and extensions. Debugging network and UI related issues. Maintenance and implementation of patches and hot fixes to the SDK.

positions.title: Lead/Senior Engineer
positions.description: Senior Software Engineer on the X360 port of, Game Developers Choice Award winner, Torchlight (Microsoft Game Studios/Runic). Responsible for: gamepad input conversion from mouse and keyboard, user interface programming, and some Xbox 360 TCR and MAT compliance. Other responsibilities included: task scheduling and tracking, project management, and aiding WDI to assemble and guide the team. Lead Software Engineer on PC to Mac port of Torchlight|Runic/Steam. In charge of ALL engineering aspects of the porting effort leveraging the Ogre Engine SDK.Also in charge of task scheduling, project planning and execution. Released on time for Steam on Mac launch day.

positions.title: Lead/Senior Engineer
positions.description: Lead Software Engineer in charge of development of a new SKU of Mavis Beacon Teaches Typing (Encore) for PC and Mac. Upgraded UI for re-release. Software Engineer on Jillian Michaels Fitness Ultimatum 2010 (Majesco) for Wii. Co-designed and implemented Wii-mote and balance board user interactions using the Vicious Engine. Integrated and implemented all exercise animations and assets. Lead Software Engineer - Built an unreleased Language Training Software prototype for iPhone. Senior Software Engineer in charge of update for re-release Wii's Ultimate Duck Hunter (Zoo). Upgraded game to new Lot Check standards, new SDK, bug fixes and prepared builds for submission. Recovered and rebuilt an inactive outdated game project, 300 (Warner Bros.), that was ported to Wii and prepped it for possible future work.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Engineer on the team responsible for Fracture (LucasArts) for X360 and PS3. Also worked concurrently on an early version of FEAR 3 (Warner Bros.) for X360, PS3 and PC. Ported and extended a level loading and verification tool for capturing data from nightly build runs on X360 dev kits. Developed programs for managing and automating processes in a 10+ node build farm in charge of building code and resources nightly for all platforms. Including features like database tracking, automated debug symbol tracking for X360, multicore support, resource processing and conversion for all platforms. Wrote the basis of a C++ network client/server program using RakNet for distributing GPU shaders to running instances of the X360 and PS3 games. Interfaced with QA to streamline the build processes and maximize their productivity; like building an automated dev kit game loaders. Led the upgrade effort of the company's X360 engine and game codebases across versions of Visual Studio. Worked with MS and Sony contacts in order to resolve compiler and build issues in their tools. Worked with FMOD engineers to track down issues in the sound conversion tools in their audio middleware package.

positions.title: Game/Tools Programmer
positions.description: Part of the development team that developed Fantastic 4 (Activision), The Sopranos (THQ) and Pirates of the Caribbean (Bethesda) for PS2, GC, PC and Xbox. Ported and extended parts of the in-house engine for the ultimately-cancelled X360 version of The Sopranos. Features added included lighting, specular and bump mapping. Prototyped an X360 and PS3 game based on the Transformers license. Developed tools for laying out levels with objects using the Havok physics engine. Developed, extended and maintained a significant part of the art side toolset and related in-game code. Developed a cutscene exporter and player; including a 3DSMax exporter plugin to extract and interleave animation data of skeletons, cameras, effects, lipsync and sound (compressed and uncompressed). Wrote MaxScripts for artists, including: a slicer that automated boolean operations of the environment geometry against portal layout data. Extended a 3rd party MaxScript to efficiently modify vertex colors. Re-implemented the environment renderer using a portal based system. Developed a 3DSMax plugin to export animation/geometric data for creating 3d animated user interfaces such as: HUDs, menu screens and various UI elements. Extended the existing environment geometry exporters and in game renderers to support transparency, lighting, hide-able geometry, texture UV offset animation.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Member of the team responsible for EI's flagship animation, modeling and rendering suite, Universe 3D v3,4&5. Designed, implemented and maintained a cross platform (Mac, Win32, Unix) layer on which all the applications would run. Developed several modules, including a font exporter, an audio component and Havok engine integration.
